home.why_desc: ProToolHub brings everyday PDF, image, video, conversion and writing tools together in one place. Many file tools run directly in your browser, while server-based tools handle the work when browser processing is not practical. There is no account to create and no software to install.
home.faq_a1: Yes. Every tool on the site is free to use and there is no paid tier at the moment. AI writing tools have a usage limit of 10 generations per 10 minutes so the service stays available to everyone.
home.faq_a2: No. There is no sign-up or login anywhere on the site. You can open any tool and start using it immediately.
home.faq_a3: It depends on the tool. Image, video and converter tools run entirely in your browser, so those files are never sent anywhere. PDF tools and AI writing tools send your input to our server over an encrypted connection, process it, and return the result.
home.faq_q4: What types of files can I process?
home.faq_a4: PDF documents, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC images, MP4, MOV and WebM video, and CSV, JSON and XML data files. Each tool page lists the formats it accepts.
home.faq_q5: Can I use ProToolHub on mobile?
home.faq_a5: Yes, the site works on phones and tablets. Video tools are the exception in practice: they encode inside your browser, which is slow on mobile and can run out of memory on longer clips. Those are better used on a desktop.
